describe: The image shows a texture sheet of four wooden crate faces in a two-by-two grid, with a few large pieces. Top left is a pale cream panel with bold orange-brown FRAGILE lettering and two red arrows. Top right is a grey-brown plank panel with horizontal boards and a dark handle hole. Bottom left is a weathered grey board panel with a diagonal brace, and bottom right is a grey board panel with a dark handle slot. Every piece must stay exactly in place.
